scope: Android local unowned data to one authenticated account; iOS unchanged
rules: Offer after successful sign-in when unclaimed local data exists; defer without changing data; offer later in account settings.
Explicit consent is bound to the current authenticated account and workspace token; active sessions and deletion block import.
Preserve existing account data. Merge exact duplicate modes/schedules; remap conflicting IDs and schedule references deterministically.
Imported schedules are disabled and have no pending alarms; preserve historical receipts and high-water marks.
Retain the destination recent-mode choice; otherwise adopt the mapped explicitly selected local mode, never the first mode.
Stream all History rows, preserve UUIDs and metadata, accept identical retries, reject conflicting UUID contents without overwrite.
Durably claim one destination before copying. A pending transfer blocks product access and account switching until retry succeeds.
Clear local source only after destination History is committed. Publish merged configuration and completion atomically; never import twice or into another account.
No network, analytics event, credentials, pairing, permission or iOS mutation is part of import. No cloud sync.
